_comment: Registry mapping direct or delegated Hugging Face Spaces whose deployed COPY surface is rooted in the listed GitHub repository. The org-wide scheduled sweep (workflows/hf-module-drift-check.yml) iterates this list and runs scripts/hf_module_drift_check.py against each pair via the git-tree API. This registry is intentionally narrower than the full source-to-HF inventory in estate/source-to-hf.v1.json: delegated subdirectory publishers and linked-but-not-published surfaces stay in that inventory until their Docker/build context is independently verified.
